issue.title: feat(dropdown): expose public single-selection menu item semantics
issue.body:
Related to [FsusBlog #1891](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1891). That assigned issue explicitly requires an atomic FsusUI issue when its mandatory public menu probe reveals an upstream capability gap.

## Public contract gap

Expose documented single-selection menu item semantics through Dropdown or a documented equivalent public primitive composition. Keep selection value, async resource/preference transactions, locale content, URLs and retry copy in the consumer.

In [dropdown-item-impl.vue at main@f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/blob/f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864/vue/packages/components/dropdown/src/dropdown-item-impl.vue), the explicit item role is computed as menuitem for a menu parent and applied after the attrs spread. Passing role=menuitemradio and aria-checked does not produce a valid radio item. The [public Dropdown API](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/blob/f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864/docs/components/dropdown.md) does not document an item checked/selection contract.

The public consumer probe is [FsusBlog commit 646d8c1a2293fa0b35eb76f8343b7f2711bbf97d](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/commit/646d8c1a2293fa0b35eb76f8343b7f2711bbf97d), under tests/frontend/probes/locale-menu. It mounts the public root exports and exercises Dropdown, Dropdown + Menu, and Select. Its runner accepts local or published mode, a dependency root, and a disposable evidence directory; exit 2 identifies capability gaps and exit 3 identifies an unavailable probe. It records current DOM observations and exact source identities. This is a prerequisite probe, not product acceptance.

## Atomic acceptance

- [ ] Document and expose menu/menuitemradio + aria-checked, or one coherent equivalent single-selection public contract.
- [ ] Preserve consumer-owned committed selection while async activation is unresolved or fails; hide-on-click=false keeps pending/error/retry reachable.
- [ ] Keep public visibility control/events, custom compact trigger slots, popup geometry/surface, disabled behavior and keyboard focus under the library owner.
- [ ] Run current browser tests for exactly one checked item, state changes, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End/Enter/Space, Escape focus return, outside dismissal, repeated open/close, disabled activation, async pending/failure/retry and cleanup.
- [ ] Support URL and command items through documented composition or an explicit public activation adapter; do not require private DOM or a second keyboard owner.
- [ ] Negative controls reject menuitem with aria-checked, half-committed selection, immediate pending close, broken Escape focus return and a private-selector workaround.
- [ ] Supply the exact upstream source commit and an accessible published package identity; the consumer probe must run against both, with no fallback.
- [ ] Cover RTL, light/dark, forced-colors, reduced-motion and narrow/wide states; update the nearest API docs and required changeset.

No locale-specific high-level component or consumer transaction belongs in FsusUI. Do not add a Blog-local generic menu, private ref/deep import repair, compatibility fallback, or dual owner. This issue requests a prerequisite capability; no merge, deployment, or issue closure is requested.
